title: ITW Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
body_markdown:
> GLENVIEW, Ill., October 27, 2026


“Our top-line results reflect accelerating demand in our capex-related segments and a meaningful increase in the contribution to revenue growth from our Customer-Back Innovation efforts. We entered the fourth quarter with strong operational momentum and are raising our EPS guidance for the year. As we continue to advance our enterprise strategy priorities, including our goal of 3 percent-plus Customer-Back Innovation yield, we are positioning ITW to deliver consistent, above-market organic growth while further expanding profitability and margins,” O’Herlihy concluded.


View the complete[Press Release](https://investor.itw.com/files/content_files/ITW-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results.pdf)
